turns.text: One option is going to the lake, but it's an hour drive and the beach has no shade.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is spending the afternoon at the mall, which is boring but at least air conditioned.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is going to the public pool in the morning before it gets too hot.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is staying home with the fan on and catching up on my shows.

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Do you have a beach umbrella? If you do, the lake could be great. If not, I'd do the pool in the morning and then relax at home with your shows.
